checks.detail: Structured surface contains only reader-facing headline/deck/blocks/closing/final-summary. No HOLD/PARTIAL/VERIFIED/MATERIAL/CONTEXT disposition tokens, no revision IDs, no promotion/demotion language, no source-consumption or retrieval-process narration; limitations expressed as reader-facing facts. The single repository path span in the bibliography URL is the audited #502 immutable public permalink, suppressed with reason.

Critical-cyber designation with monitorability-decrease caveat; all vendor benchmarks attributed without independent reproduction; Fermat as formalization/verification with no rerun and source-bounded scale/autonomy; K2 Apache 2.0 scoped to models and code; GLM-5.3 kept as medium-confidence boundary item with unresolved UTC hour and no same-week assertion; coding figures vendor-reported with methodology silence; harness GA versus preview labels preserved; spatial/video claims date-bound and vendor-bounded.

Community observation used as context only across article signal block and Week in Review; 12 ordinary posts distinguished from 3 late-breaking context items; no specification, benchmark, license, date, availability, pricing, architecture, autonomy, or transaction fact established by the observation corpus; reader-followable immutable manifest permalink cited consistently.

Closing synthesis and final summary synthesize governance/verification framing without new factual claims; unresolved items (system-card pages, reruns, closing/regulatory outcomes, reproductions, license text, methodology pages, rollout timing, leaderboard updates) carried as watch items, not resolved claims.

NVIDIA-Hugging Face transaction rendered as agreed/announced with $12.93B announced figure; openness and multi-cloud/multi-accelerator statements kept as forward-looking pledges; no completed ownership, completed regulatory clearance, or observed post-acquisition behavior asserted.
